title: headings add no words and a cited path is one word: a brief of 39 words with two cited paths is rejected as 39
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES B1, defect N-27). The length check counts words: whitespace-separated tokens that hold a letter, and the four heading lines of the brief add nothing. The brief has four headings and 39 words, two of them the cited paths `src/sync.ts` and `docs/guide.md` (both exist in the default fixture), so it is rejected with `39 words`. The oracle counts the heading words and splits each cited path on punctuation, so it counts more than 40 and accepts the brief: the exit code FAILS on TS.
